label: JS/TS silent fallback audit
description: Find catch/fallback paths that may convert meaningful JavaScript or TypeScript failures into apparently normal/default behavior.

primary.question: Can this failure handler plausibly turn a meaningful operation failure into apparently valid, default, empty, fallback, or silently incomplete behavior?

criteria.true: The shown handler or callback suppresses/replaces a failure and the local continuation can plausibly appear successful, normal, defaulted, empty, or incomplete.
criteria.false: The shown path clearly rethrows/rejects, returns an explicit error/unavailable result, or is visibly limited to cleanup, telemetry, retry, or optional UI-only behavior.

review.instructions: Judge only the bounded emitted source evidence. Do not infer hidden callers or dataflow that are not shown. Missing context is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.
review.confirmWhen: CONFIRM only when the evidence demonstrates that a caught/rejected failure is converted into normal/default/empty/incomplete caller-visible behavior without an explicit failure signal.
review.rejectWhen: Reject explicit failure/rethrow/reject, cleanup/retry/telemetry, UI-only effects, or evidence that demonstrates no outward semantic effect. Use INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE when the bounded window cannot establish the effect.
